Same files as #28556–#28558 (`packages/services/service-analytics`, dataset compiler and draft-preview path), so the four are dispatched as one card thread and one PR, sequenced on one branch.
- Dedupe: same file family as #28258 (closed by PR #28553), not the same mechanism (that was the unbacked gate). No open card on the backed preview join.
- Size/model suggestion: size M for the four together; `opus`, effort `xhigh`.
